target: Outcome of the executed retargeted Shadow grasp under a declared controller/object/physics pipeline.

uncertainty_policy.numeric: Carry independently justified/conditional arithmetic bounds without rebasing physical criteria.
uncertainty_policy.sampling: Report cell radii/weights/coverage; upper/lower estimates and adaptive query history; samepoint normal evidence does not certify cells.
uncertainty_policy.reference_geometry: Quantify visual/collider and reconstruction discrepancy as its own source of uncertainty or model mismatch, not an unearned allowance.
uncertainty_policy.anatomical_correspondence: Mark landmark/link/part matches as explicit proxies where no true homology is established.
uncertainty_policy.morphology: Systematic source-to-Shadow distortion is measured signal, not an error bar to subtract away. Do not sum unrelated uncertainties without a justified bound.
uncertainty_policy.missingness: Report unavailable/tied/buried/nonphysical domains; never convert missing comparisons to zero error or PASS.

metrics.definition: Per named homologous/proxy landmark, ||p_robot_object-p_native_object||; preserve all individual vectors, norms, tail/max and correspondence names.
metrics.reference: same object frame; explicit native MANO landmark to Shadow body-site correspondence
metrics.meaning: Kinematic displacement, not fingertip-to-object quality or physical contact.
metrics.required_coverage: all declared tips and non-tip landmarks; missing points stay missing

metrics.definition: For each declared native/robot keyvector pair, acos(clamp(dot(unit(v_native),unit(v_robot)),-1,1)); record length difference separately.
metrics.meaning: Pose morphology descriptor, distinct from hand/object surface-normal alignment.
metrics.required_coverage: all declared vectors; zero lengths undefined

metrics.definition: At common object queries q and each declared hand part f, report u_robot,f(q)-u_native,f(q), absolute change, both underlying distances and area-weighted distributions.
metrics.reference: each geometry domain measured separately; same queries/weights for the pair
metrics.meaning: Continuous native-relative geometry change. Original 1/2/5mm strata remain diagnostic scales; no new acceptance cutoff.
metrics.required_coverage: whole requested domain with available/missing area and every part; no sum of overlapping part areas as physical contact area

metrics.definition: At fixed source object queries, retain nearest native/robot part feature identities and closest points; report displacement of closest points plus distance-field change. Separately report nearest object locations for corresponding source/robot hand sites.
metrics.reference: explicit source-based query domain and nearest-feature tie policy; no task contact annotations are available
metrics.meaning: Geometric region correspondence proxy, not annotated-contact precision or measured force-bearing contact.
metrics.required_coverage: source-near, source-far and unavailable strata retained; ties are ambiguous, not zero

metrics.definition: Signed distances of corresponding hand sites and area-weighted hand surface samples to each validated closed object reference; positive outside, negative inside. Report source and robot distributions plus paired changes where correspondence exists.
metrics.reference: visible object closed mesh and compiled object collision representation are separate reports
metrics.meaning: Miss/intersection descriptors. Surface sampling gives conditional bounds or estimates, not automatically exact volume or maximum penetration.
metrics.required_coverage: full declared site/surface scope; sign unavailable on unvalidated/open geometry; normals and centroids are not forces

metrics.definition: At fixed declared object queries, a=-dot(hand outward normal,object outward normal). Retain native and mapped scores, score difference, angular difference, eligible counts/area, reason masks and reliable sign reversals.
metrics.reference: tie-free/exterior features with frozen part and domain definitions
metrics.meaning: Conditional pointwise direction evidence; no continuous claim without feature stability bounds. Missing eligibility cannot be treated as improvement.
metrics.required_coverage: all requested queries counted, including lost/new/buried/tied/inside/unavailable categories

metrics.definition: Report object/hand visual versus compiled geometry differences separately from native-to-robot mapping distortion: transforms, scaling, convexification, cavity retention, bidirectional boundaries and occupancy where valid.
metrics.reference: actual compiled geometry, not just URDF file names or rendered meshes
metrics.meaning: Identifies geometry confounding. Exposed geometric union and MuJoCo pairwise contacts are distinct.
metrics.required_coverage: global and grasp-local regions; exact versus estimated domain clearly separated

stages.name: freeze claim and source/exposure manifest
operations: deduplicate by native hash and source geometry identity
record every exposure and mapping refusal
name executed Shadow outcome as target; native MANO outcome equivalence separate
stages.exit: Complete source provenance and explicit limitations; no blind holdout may be asserted from this collection.

stages.name: close implementation correctness and reference geometry
inputs: actual compiled hand and object geometry
operations: retain prior exact native reconstruction scope and independent FK receipts
audit wrist/palm convention, global object/camera transforms, source precision and actual physical joint limits
bind input rendered/pointcloud object reference to the preserved scene geometry and processing chain
separate raw mesh, compiled convex collider, part-boundary union, exposed union and pairwise contact semantics; record cavity/mesh mismatch
stages.exit: C1 can be verified within checked source/frame/pose/compiled-scene scope while representation distortion is disclosed. Unknown or incorrect implementation metadata blocks the relevant correctness check. Cross-morphology difference alone is not a software conversion failure.

stages.name: freeze continuous static measurement contract
inputs: historical strict rule as separate immutable output
operations: declare each metric/reference/membership/normal rule before new values
carry numerical, sampling and correspondence uncertainty separately
use paired source/native/robot states without repairing native poor poses
validate algorithms on identity, frame-change, known geometric perturbation and deliberately ambiguous examples before real metric runs
stages.exit: Metric implementation and scope review complete. Measurements alone do not assign practical PASS. No manufactured control is an eval example.

stages.name: bounded development comparison and freeze mapper
inputs: same saved cases; six repeatedly fitted and 25 less surface-studied cases labeled development
operations: compare on same source inputs with paired per-case/per-object reports
report every refusal, all fingers and unavailable metric mass
allow fixed per-input solver behavior; forbid selecting only successful or visually pleasing grasps
use full geometry/reference diagnosis to avoid tuning a proxy that is unrelated to the intended representation
stages.exit: A deterministic version with passing implementation checks and clearly measured distortion can be statically ready for a later authorized study of its own Shadow outcomes (C1). This is not C2/C3 native fidelity or C4 predictor adequacy; no arbitrary geometric cutoff is needed merely to name the executed pipeline.

stages.name: optional approximate-native-fidelity allowance or task-specific scientific decision design
inputs: external geometric accuracy requirements or a distinct calibration study
prospectively selected strata and analysis method
operations: justify every allowance by external requirements or independent calibration, never current six-case pass scores
state whether the claim is geometry-only or downstream outcome adequacy
predeclare equivalence/noninferiority or sensitivity estimand, confidence procedure and sample size rationale if outcome claims are intended
freeze thresholds, aggregation/tail rules, exclusions and mapper version before locked testing
stages.exit: For C3, a non-null justified geometric budget and independent evidence are required. C1 does not need this margin. For C4, predeclare an empirical prediction/source-diversity analysis and confounding controls; do not make a universal geometric cutoff an automatic prerequisite.

stages.name: independent static generalization assessment
inputs: frozen S3 mapper/measurement method and prospective split/analysis
S4 geometric budget only if C3 approximate-native-fidelity acceptance is claimed
new unseen geometry/observations; shared object split across generators
operations: keep source-geometry aliases/decompositions/transformed copies in one split
run frozen mapper and evaluator once under prespecified stopping/accounting
retain unsupported mappings in coverage denominators
if policy or mapper is retuned, retire that test set into development rather than reuse it as blind confirmation
stages.exit: Tests the frozen pipeline and distortion outside development objects. Apply a geometric budget only when C3 is the intended claim. No source-wide generalization is inferred from the existing32.

stages.name: executed Shadow sensitivity and prediction-use validation
operations: measure whether declared retargeting/geometry differences affect Shadow outcomes under fixed controller and paired perturbations
use outcomes from actual executed mapped configurations, never transfer labels from different poses
report failure/success and mapping refusal separately; successful lift is not mandatory mapping acceptance
for multi-generator prediction keep common object splits, mapper versions and source-quality strata; compare generator mix without hiding mapper coverage artifacts
stages.exit: Supports C4 within declared execution/prediction scope through empirical performance and confounding analysis. C3 or C5 is not implicitly established or mandatory merely because the labels describe Shadow execution.

readiness_states.declared_deterministic_pipeline: Can be statically supported in checked scope with distortion; no universal morphology tolerance required.

implementation_order_now: resolve source/collider reference semantics on existing witnesses
freeze measurement and anatomical proxy definitions
then measure a fixed baseline/candidate comparison on development cases

Keep optional approximate-native-fidelity acceptance unset until justified budget and independent evidence exist; C1 pipeline correctness and C4 Shadow prediction claims follow their separate requirements.

claim_levels.claim: The native proposal is decoded correctly and a specified deterministic retargeter/scene realizes its declared Shadow pose, with measured distortion and refusals disclosed.
claim_levels.does_not_claim: Native contact/outcome equivalence, source-population generalization or useful prediction.

claim_levels.claim: Historical declared same-part band/sign relationship preservation.
Native-relative geometric distortion lies within a justified allowance for a stated use/domain.
claim_levels.does_not_block: Defining the outcome of a declared Shadow pipeline or studying it as that pipeline.

claim_levels.claim: Prediction works on executed Shadow attempts, and measured generator-mix effects survive mapper/geometry/coverage confounding controls.
The native MANO proposal and mapped robot have equivalent task outcomes.

practical_budget_applies_only_to: Optional C3 approximate-native-fidelity claim; not a prerequisite for C1 declared-pipeline correctness or merely defining Shadow outcomes.
